newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss three-month claims yield rises to 1.589 pct.
newsitem.headline: Swiss three-month claims yield rises to 1.589 pct.

text.p: The annual yield on the latest issue of Swiss federal government three-month money market claims rose to 1.589 percent from the previous issue's 1.250 percent, the Swiss National Bank said.
The issue, to be paid for on December 5, raised 1,004.65 million Swiss francs and was priced at 99.600 percent.
The previous issue of three-month claims, paid for on November 28, raised 1,140.75 million francs and was priced at 99.685 percent.
